notes.title: Hold your fire, agents!
notes.content:
[h3]We need to delay the game yet again. We understand that a lot of you are eager to finally jump into the gun-loaded hot adult action and save the day, but we need to polish the game just a little bit more. 

We're ironing out the final bugs, balancing the gameplay, and making sure every bit delivers the best it can - making actual action gameplay is challenging in some aspects, and we don't want to release an unfinished/badly polished game.

Thank you for your patience – soon enough, you’ll take action with Agent K69, armed and ready to save the city and turn up the heat! Hang tight – the streets (and more) await 😉.

The new release date is just around the corner, so be sure to keep Lust 'n Dead on your wishlist – you won’t want to miss out on the explosive action and all the spicy fun.[/h3]
